title: Conv-TasNet
subtitle: Deployment

overview.title: Artifact in input units
overview.description: Centre selection, optional DC removal and rescaling

nodes.title: Deployment input normalisation
description: Demean across configured axes; optionally divide by input standard deviation.
Packing and context axis come from the run configuration.

nodes.title: Temporal convolution stack
description: Each block emits a residual update and a skip contribution.

nodes.title: Source mask head
description: Sum skip outputs; PReLU and 1x1 projection.
Configured mask activation for each source.

nodes.title: Apply masks to encoding
description: Multiply each source mask by the original encoded features.

nodes.title: Shared synthesis decoder
description: Transposed convolution per source; crop to input length.

nodes.title: Ordered sources
description: Source 0: clean EEG; source 1: gradient artifact for the two-source setup.

nodes.title: Deployment artifact output
description: Convert the configured core output to a centre artifact.
Optionally remove prediction DC; restore the input scale.

edges.label: Deployment input normalisation to Noisy waveform
Noisy waveform to Learned analysis filters
Learned analysis filters to Normalise and project
Normalise and project to Temporal convolution stack
Temporal convolution stack to Source mask head
Source mask head to Apply masks to encoding
Apply masks to encoding to Shared synthesis decoder
Shared synthesis decoder to Ordered sources
Ordered sources to Deployment artifact output

notes: Deployment changes normalisation and objective; architecture parameters remain configuration-dependent.
Dimensions and repeated-block counts are configurable; consult the linked implementation and run configuration.
